title: Kanban changes
description: A Kanban's changes (AD-20, FR-20, latex-kanban-timeline design decision 4): set operations of the one generic diff on a card's column, addressed as item.card.column (AD-13's reference syntax without brackets), the value the ID of the column the card moved to. A Kanban never adds, removes or moves a card, edits a label or a description, or changes a column, so a card's place within a column is no change. In no schema set until latex-kanban-timeline registers it.
